content.short: Xverse is a Bitcoin wallet for managing Ordinals, Runes, BRC20, Stacks (STX) and Rare Sats.
content.description: Xverse provides a comprehensive, all-in-one solution for managing Bitcoin assets. It enables users to buy Bitcoin, maintain self-custody, and connect to the latest Bitcoin apps with ease, consolidating essential wallet capabilities into a single, intuitive interface. Users can access and showcase Ordinals, BRC20 tokens, and Rare Sats, while ensuring their assets are securely stored, including offline protection with Ledger hardware.
